mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by raising discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate at 3.08% as of 2022-10-31
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a weakening consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Housing starts at 1439.0 and retail sales at 683974.0 as of 2022-09-30
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's aggressive rate hikes lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a weakening supply chain and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 (thousands of units) signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a rapidly tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly), retail sales growth supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
